# Minecraft font

Minecraft.otf and Minecraft-Bold.otf by Idrees Hassan.
Source: https://github.com/IdreesInc/Minecraft-Font
Font license: SIL Open Font License 1.1, included as minecraft-OFL.txt.

This is an open-source rendition of the Minecraft UI typeface, not a font extracted from the game. Both font files are bundled unchanged and are used for headings, navigation, body text, buttons and fishing controls. Other bundled faces remain as fallbacks for characters outside the font's Latin glyph set.
